text: You see a man eating a bowl of cereal in the morning with water instead of milk.
You see a man staying inside his home with the shades drawn on a rare sunny day.
You see a teenage girl wearing a long trench coat on a hot summer afternoon.
You see someone driving around in a dirty car that has not been washed recently.
You see a girl taking all the Halloween candy from a bowl, leaving none for others.
You see a judge taking on a criminal case although he is friends with the defendant.
You see a student copying a classmate's answer sheet on a makeup final exam.
You see a student getting an A on a group project when he didn't do his part.
You see a man putting ketchup all over his chicken Caesar salad while at lunch.
You see a man walking down a dark hallway while still wearing his sunglasses.
You see a man wearing clothes that are clearly several sizes too big for his body.
You see a woman answering a phone call with the word "goodbye" instead of "hello.".
You see a woman continuing to wear a large sun hat inside her apartment complex.
You see a woman drinking her entire cup of coffee using a stirring spoon.
You see a woman eating dessert before her main entree arrives on the table.
You see a woman using a fork to eat a bowl of vanilla ice cream and marshmallows.
You see a woman watching a game on television in black-and-white instead of color.
You see someone at the school gym lifting free weights in nice business clothes.
You see someone reading the ending of a spy novel before reading the beginning.
You see someone using an old rotary phone and refusing to go buy a new one.
You see a boy skipping to the front of the line because his friend is an employee.
You see a girl asking for allowance even though her brother did her chores for her.
You see a manager taking half the doughnuts from a box, leaving little for others.
You see a politician using federal tax dollars to build an extension on his home.
You see a professor giving a bad grade to a student just because he dislikes him.
You see a referee intentionally making bad calls that help his favored team win.
You see a runner taking a shortcut on the course during the marathon in order to win.
You see a soccer player pretending to be seriously fouled by an opposing player.
You see a tenant bribing a landlord to be the first to get their apartment repainted.
You see a woman getting hired only because her father is close friends with the boss.
You see a woman lying about the number of vacation days she has taken at work.
You see an employee lying about how many hours she worked during the week.
You see someone cheating in a card game while playing with a group of strangers.
